_comment: Measured outcomes against CLAUDE.md. Nothing here redefines the design; it only records what was observed. Off-ledger exploration goes in FINDINGS.md, never here. RESET 2026-09-06 for the A12 rebuild: every number below M1 was discarded with the artifacts that produced them (A12, FINDINGS F5) and is being re-measured on the corrected harness. The superseded values remain in git history at febefa9.

M0.note: CLAUDE.md, the design section, locked and tagged protocol-v1

M1.note: Town01 (A3). Lit/unlit resolved (A4): site 1 unlit at 4.5, site 3 lit at 25.7 mean brightness, night lamps off

M2.note: REBUILT on the corrected harness. a_max 0.505 g (was 0.868 g -- an integration artifact, FINDINGS F5), t_lat 0.150 s over 10 reps/speed, r_req 52.0 ft at 25 mph; contact detector validated on a deliberate crash; lead oracle 10/10 perfect and 0/10 late; pedestrian oracle 10/10 and 0/10

M3.note: REBUILT. Expert 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, 14.0 ft standoff at each; capture check places a frame to 0.000 m and 0.010 of image range; scenario objects rebuilt and both oracle checks pass

M4.note: REBUILT with three arms and all THREE FMVSS lighting conditions. Every cell 10/10 on CLAUDE.md section 7's frozen pass. P_pts3 brakes at 287.57 ft in daylight on the ped scenario, 10/10 premature and 0 contacts -- a property A defect that section 7's criterion does not fail and that is recorded beside the verdict, never inside it

M5.note: REBUILT. All eight behavioural gates pass over the COVERED axis: capture 0.108-0.544, in-between 0.156-0.678. The in-between gate first failed for P_pts/ped at [+12.542, +7.715] deg (1.016); CLAUDE.md section 4's repair split it at +10.128 and the halves read 0.268 and 0.368 (FINDINGS F7)

M6.note: REBUILT. Property S over the covered axis: P_pts 4/16 and 4/16, P_cont 16/16 and 15/16, P_pts3 6/16 and 3/16. Zero undecided across all six. The third regulatory lighting condition NARROWS the falsified band (50.3 -> 43.0 deg on lead) and does not close it. Committed before any driving. Property A over the covered axis: P_cont 16/16 and 15/16, P_pts 14/16 and 12/16, P_pts3 16/16 and 1/16 -- the pedestrian arm of P_pts3 is falsified over 89.22 of the 90 degree axis, and the drives exhibit exactly that. Property A over the FMVSS 127 false-activation scenario, all three arms, 52 poses from 2.179 to 59.178 m: P_cont 16/16 covered, P_pts and P_pts3 15/16. Every verdict is identical with the plate REMOVED and every bound within 0.5%, so no falsification is attributable to the plate (F18)

M7.note: REBUILT, then extended to the plate. Twenty-four drives: midpoint and at-witness passes for three arms on lead, ped, plate and the plate-removed control. Hazard agreement: cell 4 (P_cont/lead) 17/17, cell 3 (P_cont/ped) 15/17, cell 2 (P_pts/lead) 5/17, cell 1 (P_pts/ped) 4/17. Plate agreement: cell 5 (P_pts) 17/17, cell 6 (P_cont) 16/17, P_pts3 17/17. ZERO certified-then-failed on the covered axis in any cell; the study's only one is in the A6-UNCOVERED sliver, which is excluded from every verdict by construction and is the first empirical confirmation that the sliver cannot be certified (F19). All four ledger contradictions carry written dispositions: cells 1 and 3 in F17, cell 5's certificate in F18 and its drive in F19. RE-DRIVEN END TO END on 2026-09-08: 262 of 263 sub-interval verdicts reproduce and 20 of 21 agreement counts are exact; the one flip was an instrument defect (F21). The four cells whose repetitions ever disagreed were then re-driven under amendment A13's harness -- one server, one process, one vehicle per repetition -- and none of the four was sampling: two were F21, one was the simulator drifting (F23), and the sliver plate cell stays split and is therefore VOID, failing 2/10 on the clean harness against the shared server's 6/10 (F22). F24 THEN WITHDREW THE PLATE HALF: plate_run ticked the world twice per control iteration and ran the false-activation loop at 10 Hz where CLAUDE.md section 3 specifies 20. At the specified rate P_cont does not brake on the plate at +0.013 deg -- 10/10 pass, peaks 2.00-2.18 against a 2.4525 limit -- so the study's only certified-then-failed sub-interval was a driver defect and the count is now ZERO in every cell. Every plate measurement (cells 5 and 6, F18, F19) was collected at 10 Hz and is not carried into the A14 Town12 rebuild.

M8.note: Report rewritten and both figures regenerated from the rebuilt results (dusk_gap, dusk_gap_ped, plate_gap). Remaining: the Novi demo, and formal-verification--aeb--arxiv, whose every measured number predates the A12 rebuild -- its figures/make_data.py is the only sanctioned path in
